content: The following are prognostic factors for chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL), as outlined in the referenced medical literature: 1. Nabhan C and Rosen ST (2014) conducted a clinical review on chronic lymphocytic leukemia, published in JAMA, which provides detailed insights into the disease's prognosis. The review is found in volume 312, issue 21, pages 2265–2276. 2. Hoffbrand V and Moss P discuss essential hematological principles, including chronic lymphocytic leukemia, in their authoritative textbook Essential Haematology.
